name: SubNet Internet Services
summary: Melbourne dialup/web-hosting ISP (sub.net.au, live by ~1997); merged with Cynet Services Jan 1999 (announced on both sites); later absorbed into EFTel (sub.net.au 302 to w3.eftel.com by Aug 2006). NB: Key Point/Labyrinth's history also lists SubNet among its pre-2000 takeovers — the partial-transfer reconciliation is unresolved.

events.details: Melbourne ISP; merged with Cynet Services in January 1999 (both sites carried the merger announcement).
